name: Palm Beach Holiday Boat Parade Finale at Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse
host: Marine Industries Association of Palm Beach County
venue: Intracoastal Waterway, North Palm Beach to Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse
when_note: Saturday, December 5, from 6 PM in North Palm Beach, arriving in Jupiter around 8 PM
paras: The Marine Industries Association of Palm Beach County presents the 32nd Annual Palm Beach Holiday Boat Parade on Saturday, December 5. The parade begins at 6 PM in North Palm Beach and reaches Jupiter at about 8 PM, where the grand finale takes place at the Jupiter Lighthouse.

A Zambelli traveling fireworks display leads the boats up the Intracoastal Waterway. Decorated boats compete on lights, enthusiasm and themed decor, and the association lists cash prizes for the top boats.

The association names open-to-the-public viewing sites from North Palm Beach to Jupiter, including Bert Winters Park, Sawfish Bay Park, Lighthouse Park and the Riverwalk. Guests are asked to bring a new, unwrapped toy for the Toys for Tots and Little Smiles drive.
tip: Bring a new unwrapped toy for the toy drive collected at the finale.
